system.description: Action + 5 MP: draw on one of the scene's wellsprings and apply an invocation to a creature you can see. SL1 reaches "blast" invocations, SL2 adds "hex", SL3 all. Scaling: damage +5/+10 at level 20+/40+; HP recovery and MP loss +10/+20.
